fact.en: Mistaking the Mauryan economy for 'State Socialism'—it was a mercantilist, bureaucratic economy, not a socialist one.
fact.hi: Mistaking the Mauryan economy for 'State Socialism'—it was a mercantilist, bureaucratic economy, not a socialist one.

fact.en: Assuming the Mauryans used minted coins only for trade; punch-marked silver coins were primarily for state disbursements and high-value trade.
fact.hi: Assuming the Mauryans used minted coins only for trade; punch-marked silver coins were primarily for state disbursements and high-value trade.
